fusions.name: Marked Ground
fusions.desc: You slam the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Down
fusions.desc: A crushing maul that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Reared Up
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Known Quantity
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 10%.
